mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle (id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{vehicleCode}, #{licensePlate}, #{capacityWeight}, #{capacityVolume}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle ORDER BY vehicle_code ASC
SELECT id, vehicle_code, license_plate, capacity_weight, capacity_volume, status, created_at, updated_at FROM vehicle WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY vehicle_code ASC
